_README: BRANDING - EDIT HERE. This is the ONLY place brand colours, fonts, logo and header/footer text are defined. The logo image itself is assets/logo-placeholder.png (a placeholder bar-chart icon) - see brand._logo_path to swap it. Charts (scripts/chart_style.py), the PDF report (polished-report-builder/scripts/render_report.py) and the email (newsletter-style-email-composer/scripts/build_email.py) all read this file. Change a value here, re-run the scripts, done. Keep text colours at 4.5:1 or more against white and chart/graphic colours at 3:1 or more (polished-report-builder/scripts/qa_report.py checks this). Keys starting with '_' are comments.

brand.name: Sales Analyser
brand._logo_path: PNG/JPG logo drawn top right of the PDF header band (on the blue band, so use a logo with its own white/light background or a light-coloured mark). A relative path is resolved from THIS folder (assets/), then from the report content folder. To swap the logo: either replace assets/logo-placeholder.png with your own PNG under the same name, or add your file to assets/ and put its name here. Set to "" for no logo. The email never shows the logo (no inline images - see the email skill).

text.footer_disclaimer: Management information only - not audited. Verify figures before any external or statutory use.

colors.heading: #0B2545
colors._notes: primary = brand blue (focus series, header band, links). secondary = brand green (second series, highlights). positive/negative = variance colours (negative is amber, not red, so it stays distinct from green for colour-blind readers). context = grey for comparison/prior-year/'everything else' series.

_chart_palette: Categorical order. Keep the same category-to-colour mapping across every chart in one report. Entries 4-5 are light tints: use them as fills with value labels, never for thin lines or text.

fonts._pdf_ttf: Optional paths to brand .ttf files for the PDF. If empty or missing, the PDF uses DejaVu Sans bundled with matplotlib so text matches the charts.
